description:
Title: VDOT Oracle DB Developer 
 REQ ID: 466262 
 Location: Virginia 
 LOCAL CANDIDATES STRONGLY PREFERRED 
 ONLY personal interviews will be conducted 
 
 The Virginia Department of Transportation (VDOT) Information Technology Division is seeking and PL/SQL Developer to join the Roadway Network System (RNS) and Geographical Information Systems (GIS) teams in EDM (Enterprise Data Management).
 The Information Technology Division meets VDOT's critical business needs by improving agency responsiveness, effectiveness and efficiency, through innovative research, defined architectures, planning, and optimal use of technology. RNS provides universal enterprise data access by linking geospatial and business attributes to roadway centrelines via a web-based application.
 Resource Need:
 The Virginia Department of Transportation (VDOT) Information Technology Division is seeking an PL/SQL Developer to join the Roadway Network System (RNS) and Geographical Information Systems (GIS) teams in EDM (Enterprise Data Management). The selected candidate will write and maintain/extend existing PL/SQL code to convert initial data sets, system enhancements, reports production, and improved transaction editing. The selected candidate will 
 Write and maintain/extend existing PL/SQL code to convert initial data sets, system enhancements, reports production, and improved transaction editing.
 Relies on experience and judgment to plan and accomplish goals, independently performs a variety of complicated tasks, may lead and direct the work of others, a wide degree of creativity and latitude is expected.
 Develop database packages, procedures, functions, and queries to maintain production data and address RNS production support tickets and provide development support. Emphasis on system interoperability, associating road edge vectors with tables defining route/street paths and intersections, and production-quality periodic load/import and problem diagnosis.
 Generate edit lists where manual route associations are required. 
 Archive changes to a historical database.
 Archive changes for synchronization with external databases. 
 Changes in route and street paths will cause cascading changes to events associated with route/street paths. Procedures will be developed to migrate these changes or notify business users based on type of edit and business rules. 
 Develop procedures to populate and update a separate de-normalized database for reporting purposes from the transaction database.
 Use Microsoft Team Foundation Server for source code management and team collaboration
 Communicate effectively via email and in person with technical staff, management and business stakeholders as needed in the course of performing job duties.
 Participate in code reviews and be familiar with industry best practices coding standards.
 Need 8+ years of experience with the following: 
 Write and maintain/extend existing PL/SQL code to convert initial data sets, system enhancements, reports production, and improved transaction editing
 Strong development experience and/or equivalent development skills, knowledge and work history
 Oracle 11g/12c
 PL/SQL, Toad, SQL,
 Nice to have
 SQL Developer
 SQL Loader
 Source Code and Team Management software (TFS preferred)
 Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or Information Systems

 Qualifications: 
 8 to 10 years of experience in the field or in a related area
 Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems with strong development experience or other applicable and/or equivalent development skills, knowledge and work history.
 Knowledge of and experience with the following technologies:
 Oracle 11g/12c
 PL/SQL
 Toad
 SQL
 SQL Developer
 SQL Loader
 Source Code and Team Management software (TFS preferred)
 Special Instructions to Applicants:
 This position requires a fingerprint-based background check.
